title: Measuring Context Assembly Cost in Coding-Agent Trajectories: derived data and analysis scripts
description: Derived measurements, statistical outputs and analysis scripts for the paper "Measuring Context Assembly Cost in Coding-Agent Trajectories: Limits of Identifying Software-Structure Effects from Observation" (Yoon and Kim, submitted to Science of Computer Programming). Includes per-lineage and per-session measurements with identifiers replaced by salted hashes, the 28-test analysis family under two path-resolution regimes (S1), the acquisition-threshold sensitivity analysis (S2), the path-confidence tier analysis (S3), the second-product check, the extraction, lineage-merge, path-resolution and analysis scripts, and a map from every numeric claim in the paper to the file and field that records it. Raw agent transcripts are not released. See README.md for snapshot dates and known limitations.
